annotations.title: Get an airline's missing miles request link

description: US airline frequent flyer programs: where and how to request missing miles or points for a past flight (American, Delta, United, JetBlue, Alaska/Hawaiian, Southwest, Frontier, Spirit), with the waiting period, deadline, login needs and a basic economy caveat. Passenger rights rules are not covered. Input: one airline id only; names, confirmation codes, ticket numbers and frequent flyer numbers aren't needed or used.

airline.description: The airline whose program you are asking about.
